title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Studio Display OSD. Keep it, take Continuity Card, try the console, or re-roll.

options.label: Studio Display OSD
options.thesis: The window is the display’s own overlay: black glass, one name, a hairline menu.
options.viewport: Full-bleed black. Tiny AirScreen top-left. Receiver name large and centered. One rewriting status line. Bottom: Rename · Full Screen · On Top · Require PIN as OSD text.
options.risk: Reads as a blank TV if the name is not large enough to be the object.

raised.raise: PIN is the only chromatic event; waiting stays white on black.
Status is one live rewriting line, not a lamp badge.
Waiting, pairing, live, and failed are four distinct material states.

options.label: Continuity Card
options.thesis: A centered glass plate is the receiver: name, status, then text controls — not a toolbar.
options.viewport: Dark field. Centered rounded glass card. AirScreen wordmark. Huge receiver name. Status caption. Text control row. PIN replaces the card’s interior.
options.risk: Familiar — most Apple-on-Windows clones land here.

options.label: Elbow Panel Console
options.thesis: Four pastel banks on black: the controls are the layout, the name sits in the gold segment.
options.viewport: Black window framed by a thick lilac elbow. Name in the gold bank. PIN as a numeric cluster. Rename, Full Screen, On Top, PIN as peach and periwinkle pills.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the four actions are unmistakable banks. Loses identification against Apple language.
options.risk: Reads as sci-fi hardware, not an AirPlay display.

options.label: Lexicon Spread
options.thesis: The receiver name is the headword; the PIN is the only colour plate.
options.viewport: Guide words Waiting — Pairing. Name as headword. PIN inside a bordered plate.
options.case: Loses identification and dim-room clarity: a dictionary is not a display.
options.kept: PIN is the only chromatic event.
options.risk: Cream stock fights a dim-room screen.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: Connection states print themselves as a live line on glass.
options.viewport: One 80-column field. Name. Status line rewriting. PIN as typed digits.
options.case: Loses both axes: a log is not a waiting display, and not Apple.
options.kept: Status is one live rewriting line.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.thesis: iPhone and PC as opposing members; the window tightens when they lock.
options.viewport: Name at a node. Slack waiting, taut pairing, locked live, snapped failed.
options.case: Loses both: sculpture obscures the waiting screen.
options.risk: Abstract sculpture instead of a display.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: LonelyScreen-class receiver: status, name field, and a settings toolbar, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Dark app chrome. Name + status. Toolbar: Rename, Fullscreen, Always on top, PIN.
